name: flow
description: Generic agentic workflow loop for Claude Code and Codex — 10 commands: /flow:plan (--prd) → /flow:execute (--quick) → /flow:validate (--fast, --security, --a11y, --visual, --review, --scenario) → /flow:done, plus /flow:run (a plan as a goal, opt-in capped Stop hook), /flow:bug-rca, /flow:bug-fix, /flow:release (--changelog), /flow:record-ddr and /flow:init (--context, --map, --kgai). Role agents worker/spike/scout keep contexts small (skill context-budget). Project-agnostic via <project> placeholders + per-repo .ai/workflows.config.json.
